data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Request, authorize and track returns of shipped goods.

data.name: QuickViewNote
data.value: This summary comes from the list; no other return data is loaded.

data.name: EmptyState
data.value: No returns match the current filter.

data.name: ResolveFirst
data.value: Look up the shipment and select at least one line before creating the return.

data.name: EligibilityNote
data.value: A return can be created for shipments that are Delivered or Closed.

data.name: ShipmentIneligible
data.value: This shipment’s status does not allow a return.

data.name: ReturnLinesHelp
data.value: Select each shipment line to return and enter its quantity. The shipped quantity is shown for reference only; it is not the remaining quantity.

data.name: ReturnQuantityHelp
data.value: Sent exactly as typed, for example 2 or 1.5.

data.name: NoShipmentLines
data.value: This shipment has no lines to return.

data.name: EvidenceHelp
data.value: Optional. References are sent in the order shown.

data.name: ReturnCreateReplayed
data.value: This return was already created by the same request and is shown as completed.

data.name: ReceivedManualNote
data.value: Receiving is a manual assertion only. It is not a warehouse receipt and posts no stock movement.

data.name: OccurredAtHelp
data.value: Date and time with offset, for example 2026-09-26T14:30:00+03:00.

data.name: DispositionCodeHelp
data.value: Required for this status. Sent exactly as typed.

data.name: InventoryReferenceHelp
data.value: Optional. Stored as text and not verified against inventory.

data.name: ConfirmTransition
data.value: Change the return status to the selected value?

data.name: TransitionReplayed
data.value: This status change was already applied by the same request and is shown as completed.

data.name: RequestPending
data.value: A request for this action is still in progress.

data.name: NoticeSessionEnded
data.value: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

data.name: NoticeForbidden
data.value: You are not authorized for this action.

data.name: NoticeUnsupportedMedia
data.value: The request format is not supported.

data.name: ErrInvalidRequest
data.value: The request is not valid. Check the entered values.

data.name: ErrReturnNotFound
data.value: The record was not found or is not available to you.

data.name: ErrShipmentNotFound
data.value: The record was not found or is not available to you.

data.name: ErrShipmentLineNotFound
data.value: A selected shipment line no longer exists on the shipment.

data.name: ErrInvalidReturnTransition
data.value: The return has changed in the meantime and this status change is no longer possible. The list has been reloaded.

data.name: ErrDispositionRequired
data.value: Enter a disposition code for this status.

data.name: ErrInvalidReturnQuantity
data.value: Each return quantity must be greater than zero.

data.name: ErrReturnQuantityExceeded
data.value: The return quantity exceeds the shipped quantity still open for return.

data.name: ErrReturnUomMismatch
data.value: The unit of measure does not match the shipment line.

data.name: ErrDuplicateReturnLine
data.value: The same shipment line appears more than once.

data.name: ErrShipmentNotReturnable
data.value: The shipment’s status does not allow a return.

data.name: ErrCorrelationRootMismatch
data.value: The request no longer matches the shipment record.

data.name: ErrIdempotencyKeyReused
data.value: This request was already used with different values. Start a new action.

data.name: ErrReturnSourceChanged
data.value: The shipment has changed since the first return for it. Review the shipment; nothing was adjusted automatically.

data.name: ErrReturnShipmentRootInvalid
data.value: The shipment reference data is invalid. Please contact support.

data.name: ErrDependencyResponseInvalid
data.value: The shipment data returned by the source system is invalid. Please contact support.

data.name: ErrReturnShipmentRootUnavailable
data.value: The shipment reference data is incomplete. Try the same request again later.

data.name: ErrReferenceStateUnavailable
data.value: The shipment state is temporarily unavailable. Try the same request again.

data.name: ErrDependencyUnavailable
data.value: The shipment reference data is temporarily unavailable. Try the same request again.

data.name: ErrPersistenceUnavailable
data.value: Returns are temporarily unavailable. The outcome is not confirmed; try the same request again.

data.name: ErrInternalError
data.value: An unexpected error occurred. You can retry the same action.
